newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania suffer setback in victory chase.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania suffer setback in victory chase.

text.p: Tasmania lost dashing batsman Michael DiVenuto off the last ball before lunch in a major blow to their victory hopes in the Sheffield Shield match against South Australia.
At the break, with two sessions remaining, Tasmania were 52 for two in pursuit of their victory target of 349 at Bellerive Oval.
South Australia declared their second innings on 209 for five after resuming on the fourth and final day on 127 for three.
Tasmania scored 248 in their first innings in reply to the visitors' 387.
